raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
H ^ {\prime} = a ^ {3} V _ {0} \delta (x - a / 4) \delta (y - a / 2) \delta (z - 3 a / 4).
$$

求出基态和第一激发态(三重简并)能量的一阶修正.
raw_problem.solution_text:
对于三维无限深方势阱，波函数的通式为

$$
\psi_ {m, n, p} ^ {0} (x, y, z) = \left(\frac {2}{a}\right) ^ {1 / 2} \left(\frac {2}{b}\right) ^ {1 / 2} \left(\frac {2}{c}\right) ^ {1 / 2} \sin \left(\frac {m \pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {n \pi y}{b}\right) \sin \left(\frac {p \pi z}{c}\right),
$$

所以基态波函数为

$$
\psi_ {1 1 1} ^ {0} (x, y, z) = \left(\frac {2}{a}\right) ^ {3 / 2} \sin \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right),
$$

自能量非简并'直接用能量一阶修正公式

$$
\begin{array}{l} E ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {1 1 1} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {1 1 1} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = 8 V _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right) \\ \cdot \delta (x - a / 4) \delta (y - a / 2) \delta (z - 3 a / 4) d x d y d z \\ = 8 V _ {0} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {3 \pi}{4}\right) \\ = 2 V _ {0}. \\ \end{array}
$$

对于第一激发态，三重简并的被函数分别为

$$
\psi_ {a} ^ {0} = \psi_ {2 1 1} ^ {0} (x, y, z) = \left(\frac {2}{a}\right) ^ {3 / 2} \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right),
$$

$$
\psi_ {b} ^ {0} = \psi_ {1 2 1} ^ {0} (x, y, z) = \left(\frac {2}{a}\right) ^ {3 / 2} \sin \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi y}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right),
$$

$$
\psi_ {c} ^ {0} = \psi_ {1 1 2} ^ {0} (x, y, z) = \left(\frac {2}{a}\right) ^ {3 / 2} \sin \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi z}{a}\right).
$$

在简并子雪雪雪间求出 $H ^ { \prime }$ 的矩阵元.首先，由于波函数和哈密顿量都是实的，因此 $w$ 矩阵是一个实矩阵由于 $w$ 矩阵是厄米矩阵，所以 $W _ { i j } = W _ { j i }$ .

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {a a} = \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = 8 V _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {2 \pi x}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right) \\ \cdot \delta (x - a / 4) \delta (y - a / 2) \delta (z - 3 a / 4) d x d y d z \\ = 8 V _ {0} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {3 \pi}{4}\right) \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = 4 V _ {0}. \\ W _ {b b} = \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = 8 V _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {2 \pi y}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right) \\ \cdot \delta (x - a / 4) \delta (y - a / 2) \cdot \delta (z - 3 a / 4) d x d y d z \\ = 8 V _ {0} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) \sin^ {2} (\pi) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {3 \pi}{4}\right) \\ = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {c c} = \left\langle \psi_ {c c} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {c c} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = 8 V _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {2 \pi z}{a}\right) \\ \cdot \delta (x - a / 4) \delta (y - a / 2) \delta (z - 3 a / 4) d x d y d z \\ = 8 V _ {0} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {3 \pi}{2}\right) \\ = 4 V _ {0}. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {a b} = \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = 8 V _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi y}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right) \\ \cdot \delta (x - a / 4) \delta (y - a / 2) \delta (z - 3 a / 4) d x d y d z \\ = 8 V _ {0} \sin \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin (\pi) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {3 \pi}{4}\right) \\ = 0 = W _ {b a}. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {a c} = \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {c} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = 8 V _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi z}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right) \\ \cdot \delta (x - a / 4) \delta (y - a / 2) \delta (z - 3 a / 4) d x d y d z \\ = 8 V _ {0} \sin \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac {3 \pi}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac {3 \pi}{4}\right) \\ = - 4 V _ {0} = W _ {c a}. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {b c} = \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {c} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = 8 V _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \int_ {0} ^ {a} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi x}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi y}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi y}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\pi z}{a}\right) \sin \left(\frac {2 \pi z}{a}\right) \\ \cdot \delta (x - a / 4) \delta (y - a / 2) \delta (z - 3 a / 4) d x d y d z \\ = 8 V _ {0} \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) \sin (\pi) \sin \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac {3 \pi}{4}\right) \sin \left(\frac {3 \pi}{2}\right) \\ = 0 = W _ {c b}. \\ \end{array}
$$

于是 $w$ 矩阵的具体形式可以写为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {W}} = 4 V _ {0} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ - 1 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

设本征值为 $4 V _ { 0 } \kappa$ ，解久期方程，得

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c c} 1 - \kappa & 0 & - 1 \\ 0 & - \kappa & 0 \\ - 1 & 0 & 1 - \kappa \end{array} \right| = 0 \Rightarrow - (1 - \kappa) ^ {2} \kappa + \kappa = 0 \Rightarrow \kappa = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 0 \\ 0 \\ 2 \end{array} \right.,
$$

所以第一激发态的一阶能量修正为 $0 , 0 , 8 V _ { 0 }$ .原有的简并得到了部分消除.

串习题 7.12 一个量子系统仅有三个线性独立的态.假设其哈密顿量的矩阵形式为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} = V _ {0} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} (1 - \varepsilon) & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & \varepsilon \\ 0 & \varepsilon & 2 \end{array} \right),
$$

其中 $V _ { 0 }$ 为常数， $\varepsilon$ 为一小量 $( \varepsilon \ll 1 )$ .

(a) 求无微扰 $( \varepsilon = 0 )$ 时，哈密顿量的本征矢和本征值.  
(b) 严格求解 $\mathcal { H }$ 的本征值.将结果展开为 $\varepsilon$ 的罪级数至二阶项.   
利用一阶和二阶非简并微扰理论，求解 $\mathcal { H } ^ { \mathrm { 0 } }$ 的非简并本征矢所产生态的近似本征值，并同 中精确结果作对比  
(d) 利用简并微扰理论，求出两个初始简并的本征值的一阶修正，并同精确结果作对比.

解答 (时无微扰情况下哈密顿量的矩阵表示为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {0} = V _ {0} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{array} \right),
$$

己是一个对角矩阵，它的对角元就是11. $\pmb { \mathcal { H } } ^ { 0 }$ 的本征值.本征值为 $V _ { 0 } , V _ { 0 } , 2 V _ { 0 }$ ，对应的本征态为

$$
\left| \psi_ {1} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right), \quad \left| \psi_ {2} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \left( \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right), \quad \left| \psi_ {3} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \left( \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

(b) 设本征值为 $\lambda V _ { 0 }$ ，哈密顿量 $H$ 的久期方程为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \det  \left(H - \lambda V _ {0}\right) = V _ {0} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 1 - \varepsilon - \lambda & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 - \lambda & \varepsilon \\ 0 & \varepsilon & 2 - \lambda \end{array} \right| = 0 \\ \Rightarrow (1 - \varepsilon - \lambda) (\lambda^ {2} - 3 \lambda + 2 - \varepsilon^ {2}) = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

所以 λ1 = 1 $- \varepsilon , \quad \lambda _ { 2 } = \frac { 3 } { 2 } - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \sqrt { 1 + 4 \varepsilon ^ { 2 } } , \quad \lambda _ { 3 } = \frac { 3 } { 2 } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } \sqrt { 1 + 4 \varepsilon ^ { 2 } } .$

能量本征值为

$$
E _ {1} = (1 - \varepsilon) V _ {0},
$$

$$
E _ {2} = \frac {3 V _ {0}}{2} - \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \sqrt {1 + 4 \varepsilon^ {2}},
$$

$$
E _ {3} = \frac {3 V _ {0}}{2} + \frac {V _ {0}}{2} \sqrt {1 + 4 \varepsilon^ {2}}.
$$

利用函数展开式

$$
\sqrt {1 + x} = 1 + \frac {1}{2} x - \frac {3}{8} x ^ {2} + \frac {5}{1 6} x ^ {3} - \dots
$$

可以将本征值 $ { { \cal E } } _ { 2 , 3 }$ 展开为关于 $\varepsilon$ 的级数，精确至三阶项，得

$$
E _ {2} \approx \left(1 - \varepsilon^ {2}\right) V _ {0}, \quad E _ {3} \approx \left(2 + \varepsilon^ {2}\right) V _ {0}.
$$

(c) 微扰哈密顿量的矩阵表示为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {\prime} = \boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} - \boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {0} = V _ {0} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} - \varepsilon & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \varepsilon \\ 0 & \varepsilon & 0 \end{array} \right) = \boldsymbol {\mathcal {W}},
$$

$\left| \psi _ { 3 } ^ { 0 } \right.$ 非简井，一阶能量修正为

$$
E _ {3} ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {3} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {3} ^ {0} \right\rangle = W _ {3 3} = 0.
$$

二阶能量修正为

$$
E _ {3} ^ {2} = \frac {\left| W _ {1 3} \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {3} ^ {0} - E _ {1} ^ {0}} + \frac {\left| W _ {2 3} \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {3} ^ {0} - E _ {2} ^ {0}} = \frac {\varepsilon^ {2} V _ {0} ^ {2}}{2 V _ {0} - V _ {0}} = \varepsilon^ {2} V _ {0}.
$$

所以在三阶修正下非筒并态 $\left| \psi _ { 3 } ^ { 0 } \right.$ 的能量为

$$
E _ {3} = 2 V _ {0} + \varepsilon^ {2} V _ {0}.
$$

它正好是 (b) 中 $E _ { 3 }$ 的精确解关于 $\varepsilon$ 的展开式精确至二阶的结果.

(d) 下面考虑有二重筒并的本征态 $\left| \psi _ { 1 } ^ { 0 } \right.$ 和 $\left| \psi _ { 2 } ^ { 0 } \right.$ ，微扰矩阵元为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {\prime} = V _ {0} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \varepsilon & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \varepsilon \\ 0 & \varepsilon & 0 \end{array} \right],
$$

由此， $w$ 矩阵元为

$$
W _ {1 1} = \left\langle \psi_ {1} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {1} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \end{array} \right] V _ {0} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \varepsilon & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \varepsilon \\ 0 & \varepsilon & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right] = - \varepsilon V _ {0}.
$$

$$
W _ {2 2} = \left\langle \psi_ {2} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {2} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right] V _ {0} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \varepsilon & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \varepsilon \\ 0 & \varepsilon & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right] = 0.
$$

$$
W _ {1 2} = W _ {2 1} = \left\langle \psi_ {1} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {2} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \left[ \begin{array}{l l l} 1 & 0 & 0 \end{array} \right] V _ {0} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - \varepsilon & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \varepsilon \\ 0 & \varepsilon & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{l} 0 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right] = 0.
$$

所以， 矩阵为

$$
\boldsymbol {w} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c} - \varepsilon V _ {0} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right],
$$

久期方程为

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} - \varepsilon V _ {0} - E ^ {1} & 0 \\ 0 & - E ^ {1} \end{array} \right| = 0,
$$

解久期方程，得

$$
E ^ {1} = 0   \text {或}   -   \varepsilon V _ {0}.
$$

于是简并情况的能量经过一阶修正之后为

$$
E _ {1} = V _ {0} - \varepsilon V _ {0}, \quad E _ {2} = V _ {0},
$$

能量简并被捎除与 (b) 中的结果作对比可知，上式与精确解在保留到一阶项时的结果一致.
